items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: he came all the way around to the house on the middle... So try him out.

ctx.x: And let's see, we've got the rhythm covered. Louis Balbrin, did he ever play one job? No, he never played, Stan Lee All-Innes.

Never played one job. Well, we got Fats Martin, somebody told me a good drummer at that story. Oh, yeah. And he came all the way around to the house on the middle. He was like a lag mother. I said, man, this guy came from all his house. But he gave me a good story about how he was going and he was clearing all this vetting out about later that hour. And the guy killed him. I said, well, this guy must be able to pick something anyhow. So try him out.

Who came with at the Astoria? I don't know. Both of them up there? Yeah, they had a great stage in my life. Yeah, well, he recorded with Lee up there. Oh, he did, yeah. Yeah, with Lee and Professor Davy Jones. Right, like I got him.
